The Artisan Rectangular Vault — A Handwoven Cane Box for the Objects That Define You

There is a category of object that exists not merely to store, but to honour. The Artisan Rectangular Vault is one such object. When harvested sustainably and woven entirely by hand — without industrial machinery, synthetic adhesives, or fossil-fuel-derived finishes — it becomes one of the most carbon-efficient materials in the luxury home and accessories market.

  • Biogenic carbon storage — cane actively sequesters CO₂ during its growth cycle
  • 100% biodegradable and fully compostable at end of life — zero microplastics, zero landfill burden
  • Manual craftsmanship — no energy-intensive industrial machinery, no fossil-fuel-powered production
  • Supporting artisan livelihoods built on near-zero-emission, community-based craft economies

Wipe with a dry or slightly damp cloth. Avoid soaking or machine washing. Store in a dry, ventilated space. If the basket gets wet, allow it to air-dry fully in shade to preserve its shape and fibers.

descriptionHtml:
Your Walls Deserve Better Than a Plastic Shelf.

Most storage solutions are an afterthought — functional, forgettable, and ugly. This Water Hyacinth Wall & Vanity Organiser is different. Its dense, hand-braided weave gives it the warmth of a craft object and the utility of a serious storage piece. Mount it in your kitchen, hang it on your balcony, or set it on your bathroom vanity — it looks intentional wherever it lands.

Hand-woven by skilled artisans from 100% natural water hyacinth, each basket carries the quiet confidence of something made by hand. The tight braid pattern means it holds its shape under daily use, while the natural honey-brown tone complements marble, concrete, wood, and terracotta alike.

Three Ways to Use It

  • Wall-mounted kitchen organiser — hang with jute rope or wall hooks; holds spice jars, utensils, condiment bottles, and sachets
  • Bathroom vanity tray — sits flat on marble or stone countertops; perfect for skincare bottles, rolled towels, and grooming essentials
  • Balcony or garden hanging basket — suspend from hooks to store herb pots, dried flowers, scissors, and garden tools

Why It Works

  • Dense braid weave — structured and sturdy; holds shape without sagging
  • Naturally moisture-resistant — wipe-clean surface, suited for bathroom and kitchen environments
  • Versatile mounting: flat base for countertop use, rope-ready for wall hanging
  • 100% natural water hyacinth — sustainable, biodegradable, zero plastic
  • Merges traditional Indian grasscrafts with a modern minimalist aesthetic
  • Each basket is uniquely hand-woven — no two are identical

Dimensions

14" L × 10" H × 7" W

Free shipping on orders above ₹1,250.

Care Instructions

  • Wipe clean with a dry or slightly damp cloth — avoid soaking or submerging in water
  • Keep away from prolonged direct sunlight to preserve the natural colour
  • Store in a dry, well-ventilated space when not in use
  • Reshape gently if needed — the natural fibres respond well to light misting and air-drying
  • If wall-mounting, use hooks rated for at least 2kg; jute rope is included for hanging

Frequently Asked Questions

Can this be wall-mounted?
Yes — the basket is designed for wall hanging. Use two sturdy hooks (included jute rope loops make it easy) or mount directly on a rail. It's shown in our images hung in a kitchen and on a balcony wall.

Is it suitable for a bathroom vanity?
Absolutely. The dense braid weave is naturally moisture-resistant, making it well-suited for bathroom countertops. Avoid leaving it in standing water or directly under a shower spray.

What can I store in it?
Skincare bottles, rolled hand towels, spice jars, utensils, herb pots, dried flowers, stationery, remote controls — it handles daily-use items beautifully in any room.

What are the dimensions?
14" L × 10" H × 7" W — a generous size that holds more than it looks. The structured walls keep contents upright and accessible.

Is it the same as the Heritage Basket?
No. The Heritage Basket uses an open-weave pattern and is designed as a gift hamper vessel. This organiser uses a dense braid weave, is larger (14×10×7 vs 12×9×5), and is purpose-built for wall mounting and everyday storage.

Is water hyacinth sustainable?
Yes. Water hyacinth is an invasive aquatic plant — harvesting it for craft actually helps restore local ecosystems. Our baskets divert approximately 850g of plant matter that would otherwise choke waterways, while saving an estimated 2,400 litres of water compared to conventional materials.
